heroSlides.title: Discover Authentic Ethiopian Crafts
heroSlides.subtitle: Handcrafted Treasures from the Heart of Africa
heroSlides.description: Connect with skilled artisans and discover unique pieces that blend centuries-old traditions with contemporary design.
heroSlides.description_am: እያንዳንዱ ጽሑፍ በትውልዶች ውስጥ የተላለፉ የባህል ኩራት፣ የኪነጥበብ ቁርጠኝነት እና ዘላቂ የእጅ ጥበብ ታሪክን ይተርካል።

heroSlides.title: Where Heritage Meets Modernity
heroSlides.subtitle: Timeless Craftsmanship for the Global Citizen
heroSlides.description: Each piece tells a story of cultural pride, artistic dedication, and sustainable craftsmanship passed through generations.

heroSlides.title: Sustainable Luxury
heroSlides.subtitle: Conscious Choices for a Better World
heroSlides.description: Support ethical fashion and traditional crafts while owning pieces that are as unique as their cultural heritage.
heroSlides.description_am: እያንዳንዱ ጽሑፍ በትውልዶች ውስጥ የተላለፉ የባህል ኩራት፣ የኪነጥበብ ቁርጠኝነት እና ዘላቂ የእጅ ጥበብ ታሪክን ይተርካል

heritageDescription_en: [EN] በኢትዮ-ክራፍት ግሎባል ላይ ያለ እያንዳንዱ ምርት የባህል ታሪኩን ይዞ ይቀርባል፣ ይህም ከትውልድ ወደ ትውልድ ከተላለፉ የበለፀጉ ቅርሶች እና ባህላዊ ቴክኒኮች ጋር ያገናኝዎታል።
